name: Classic Image Hovers for Elementor
author: Classic Addons

sections.description:
Classic Image Hovers is a powerful and lightweight Elementor addon that allows you to add stunning hover effects to images with customizable captions. Enhance your website’s visual appeal by adding dynamic overlays, stylish animations, and interactive captions—all without writing a single line of code!

Quick Links

  • Live Demo
  • More Info

🚀 Why Use Classic Image Hovers?
✅ Seamless Elementor Integration – Designed to work flawlessly with Elementor, making it easy to use for beginners and professionals alike.
✅ 100+ Hover Effects – Choose from a variety of animation styles like zoom, slide, fade, and break-piece effects.
✅ Customizable Captions – Adjust text size, color, alignment, and typography to match your brand.
✅ Link Support – Add clickable image captions to drive user engagement.
✅ Mobile Responsive – Ensures a seamless experience across all devices.
✅ Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance to keep your site speed intact.
✅ No Coding Required – Everything is managed through an intuitive drag-and-drop interface.

🎨 Key Features
🔹 Hover Effects – Apply animation effects such as Slide Up, Fade, Flip, Zoom, Rotate, and many more.
🔹 Caption Styles – Position captions at the top, bottom, or full overlay with customized colors and fonts.
🔹 Image Overlays – Add stylish overlays to enhance image appearance.
🔹 Custom Image Sizes – Set custom dimensions for each image.
🔹 Break Pieces Effect – Unique image disintegration effect to grab attention.
🔹 Image Scroll – Scroll image vertically on hover.
🔹 Fully Customizable – Modify effects, animations, and transitions to fit your design needs.

🎯 Who Can Benefit from This Plugin?
✅ Bloggers & Content Creators
✅ eCommerce Store Owners
✅ Photographers & Artists
✅ Web Designers & Developers
✅ Businesses & Agencies

📌 How It Works?
1️⃣ Install & activate the plugin.
2️⃣ Open Elementor and add the Classic Image Hover widget.
3️⃣ Upload an image and customize the caption & effects.
4️⃣ Save & publish—your stylish image hover effect is now live!

📢 Why Choose Classic Image Hovers?
With over 100+ hover effects, full customization options, and zero coding required, this plugin is the perfect tool for creating visually appealing image captions that engage users and improve your site’s aesthetics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor and add the Classic Image Hover widget to your page.
  4. Configure the settings as per your needs and enjoy the stylish hover effects!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any theme?

Yes, it is compatible with most WordPress themes that support Elementor.

Can I use this plugin without Elementor?

No, this plugin is designed specifically for Elementor and requires it to function properly.

Are the effects customizable?

Yes, you can change overlay styles, captions, and animations via Elementor’s settings.
